summary: Full backend + frontend testing for CA Yogesh Trivedi landing site. All 5 pytest cases pass. Frontend verified end-to-end: hero renders, nav/CTAs scroll with Lenis, all 30+ data-testids present (stats, problems, values, process, results, timeline, contact, footer), phone tel href correct, email copy toggles to 'COPIED', chat widget opens, suggested prompt streams a relevant Claude response mentioning Health Check / CFO, messages persist across reload via yt_chat_session localStorage key, reset clears history. Mobile (390x844): nav-mobile-toggle opens nav-mobile-menu, zero horizontal overflow. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Portrait fallback shows 'YT' monogram since /portrait.jpg missing — expected per spec but worth noting a real image would strengthen credibility.
chat.py streams provider errors inline as data events (good) but does not persist partial assistant text if stream errors mid-way — acceptable trade-off.
seed_data_creation: pytest created and deleted its own session rows (TEST_/pytest- prefix). Also one UI chat session created during browser test and left behind (session 990276bc-...); negligible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_chat.py (5 passing). Frontend uses Lenis so after clicking nav links wait ~1.5-2s before asserting scroll. Chat stream takes 5-20s to produce a reply; wait up to 30s for first assistant bubble and additional ~8s to accumulate text. Session id is in localStorage key yt_chat_session.
